snippet.title: Space-Pilot II (C64 Longplay)
snippet.description:
Hot on the heels on yesterday's Space-Pilot comes the sequel.

Released the following year, 1985, and a hybrid of Time Pilot and Time Pilot '84. The aim is to survive around 70 seconds on each stage. It's an enjoyable game, though suffers from slowdown at times, and also pauses itself at random moments!

There are 8 stages in total, after which it wraps back to stage 1.

Coded by Henrik Wening.
